facts.text: The container installs ROS 2 Humble with ros-humble-desktop.
The image downloads LunarSim.tar.xz from the project's releases/latest URL and extracts LunarSim.x86_64.
The README runs the extracted simulator binary with ./LunarSim.x86_64.
The README warns not to source ROS in the terminal where LunarSim runs.

The README's ROS 2 Topics section lists /cmd_vel as the subscribed topic and five published topics: /lunarsim/gt/pose, /lunarsim/imu, the left and right camera images and the depth image; it documents no service, action, pause, reset or stop endpoint.
The README documents /cmd_vel as a geometry_msgs/Twist velocity command for the robot.
The README example publishes one geometry_msgs/msg/Twist on /cmd_vel with linear.x 1.0 and angular.z 0.0.
The README documents /lunarsim/gt/pose as a geometry_msgs/PoseStamped ground-truth robot pose.
The README documents /lunarsim/imu as sensor_msgs/Imu data.
The README documents /lunarsim/camera_left/raw as a sensor_msgs/Image left camera image.
The README documents /lunarsim/camera_right/raw as a sensor_msgs/Image right camera image.
The README documents /lunarsim/camera_depth/depth as a sensor_msgs/Image depth image.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned replies; no LunarSim binary, physics step, sensor renderer, wall-clock pacing or state-hash replay. It is not a recording of live ROS traffic.

fidelity.engine: analytic:ROS-free contract fake with canned placeholder replies (no physics)
gaps: the fake is a ROS-free RecordingRosTransport: it answers the declared /cmd_vel publication and the five declared subscriptions with placeholder messages and runs no LunarSim binary, ROS graph, physics, renderer or wall-clock loop
the pose, IMU and image values are placeholders and do not move, accelerate or update; a live run must receive the simulator's own samples

the upstream simulator binary is downloaded from the latest release (Dockerfile:55-59), not built from the clone, so its internal timing, physics, camera encodings and image dimensions are not available in the pinned source
the fake returns a 4x2 BGR8 left/right frame and a 4x2 16UC1 depth frame; the real camera sizes and encodings are not stated in the clone and the SDK rejects encodings outside its supported set

the README also documents /lunarsim/camera_left/compressed and /lunarsim/camera_right/compressed (README.md:79, README.md:87); those CompressedImage streams are NOT COVERED and the driver selects the raw Image streams
no stop, pause or reset service or action exists in the pinned clone; a zero-velocity Twist is transmission-only and the fake does not invent an acknowledgement
a live run requires the operator's LunarSim container, ROS 2 Humble graph and rosbridge WebSocket endpoint; none of them is started or validated here

safe_state.description: No acknowledged ROS stop, pause or reset service or action exists in the pinned clone: /cmd_vel is an unacknowledged Twist publication, so this package declares no safe state and the stock e-stop only latches it in software without claiming that the simulated rover stopped.
